title: 3A Event Venue Grand Opening!
seo_title: 3A Event Venue Grand Opening in Joplin, MO
description: This is a grand opening celebration for the new 3A Event Venue, with live music, food trucks and drinks, local vendors, bounce houses, and face painting. Admission is free and the event is for all ages; anyone who books and pays a deposit during the opening gets 20% off venue bookings. It takes place on November 22, 2026 (Time TBD) at 2873 S Kenser Rd in Joplin, MO.
address: 2873 S Kenser Rd, Joplin, MO 64801-7737, United States, Joplin, MO
